doc.title: Frank Tiberi interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 30, 2022

title: Current playing and age
summary: Tiberi describes upcoming gigs in Rochester and Monk club and his health at 92.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: And how much playing are you doing yourself these days?
Well George and I have a concert going up in Rochester at the jazz festival.
That’s a beautiful jazz festival they have.

Yeah John Nugent is the — and then there’s a club over here which is a Chinese place, or a Japanese place it’s called the Monk, we’ve got a gig over there actually. And something else came up, and I have a few. So I keep myself pretty much occupied and practicing.
Yeah I’m looking at a quote here from an earlier interview: “Even at my age I have a duffel bag packed and I’m ready to go.”

My age, right? Oh boy. It’s a little hard actually but I don’t really feel as if I’m in the stage of — well I’m in the 93rd year. Of course I’m not 93 years old until December. And I just, it’s hard to move of course but I just function just as well as I feel as if I’m 60 or 70. I mean I don’t really feel anything — I haven’t really accepted that I’m that age. And I walk on glass of course. I’m really careful.
